<section class="grignan-home grignan-satire">

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Comfortaa:wght@700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;0,900;1,700&display=swap');

/* =====================================
   FOND ET DÉCORATIONS
===================================== */

html, body, #quarto-content {
  background-color: #F4F0E8 !important;
}

.grignan-home {
  display: block !important;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  color: #293747;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.grignan-home * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.lavande-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  right: 15px;
  bottom: 10px;
  width: 190px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.16;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.ble-filigrane {
  position: fixed;
  left: 8px;
  bottom: 15px;
  width: 175px;
  height: auto;
  opacity: 0.18;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* =====================================
   EN-TÊTE FAÇON GAZETTE SATIRIQUE
===================================== */

.gazette-masthead {
  margin: 30px 0 32px;
  padding: 28px 24px;
  background: #f0fff4;
  border: 2px solid #9ae6b4;
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 14px rgba(47, 133, 90, 0.08);
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.gazette-hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  right: -14px;
  bottom: -18px;
  width: 225px;
  height: 225px;
  opacity: 0.08;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  transform: rotate(-8deg);
}

.gazette-masthead > *:not(.gazette-hero-bg) {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.gazette-topbar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1.5px solid #9ae6b4;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #2f855a;
}

.gazette-price-tag {
  background: #2f855a;
  color: #ffffff;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.gh-section-badge--satire {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding: 5px 13px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: #c6f6d5;
  color: #2f855a;
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.grignan-home .gazette-masthead h2 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 30px !important;
  color: #26394d !important;
  margin: 0 0 14px !important;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center !important;
  border: none !important;
}

.gazette-slogan-banner {
  margin: 14px auto 14px;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  background: #2f855a;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 19px;
  line-height: 1.4;
  max-width: 720px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
}

.gazette-intro {
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: #4a5568;
  margin: 0 auto;
  max-width: 720px;
}

/* =====================================
   TITRES DE RUBRIQUES
===================================== */

.satire-rubrique-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 34px 0 18px;
}

.satire-rubrique-line {
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: #c6f6d5;
}

.grignan-home .satire-rubrique-header h3 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 18px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #26394d !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 6px 16px !important;
  background: #f0fff4;
  border: 1px solid #9ae6b4;
  border-radius: 20px;
  text-align: center !important;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* =====================================
   GRILLE DES 4 IDÉES DE VIDÉOS SATIRIQUES
===================================== */

.grignan-home .video-ideas-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  gap: 18px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

.grignan-home .video-idea-card {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  padding: 20px !important;
  background: #f7f8f8 !important;
  border: 1px solid #c6f6d5 !important;
  border-top: 4px solid #547b9f !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(47, 133, 90, 0.05);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.grignan-home .video-idea-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(47, 133, 90, 0.11);
}

.video-idea-card--crimson {
  border-top-color: #8c2d2d !important;
}

.video-idea-card--ochre {
  border-top-color: #c39a54 !important;
}

.video-idea-card--teal {
  border-top-color: #2f855a !important;
}

.video-idea-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.video-idea-format {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #547b9f;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.video-idea-card--crimson .video-idea-format { color: #8c2d2d; }
.video-idea-card--ochre .video-idea-format { color: #967337; }
.video-idea-card--teal .video-idea-format { color: #2f855a; }

.video-idea-badge {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: #edf3f8;
  color: #385d7d;
}

.video-idea-card--crimson .video-idea-badge { background: #f9ecec; color: #8c2d2d; }
.video-idea-card--ochre .video-idea-badge { background: #f8f1e5; color: #967337; }
.video-idea-card--teal .video-idea-badge { background: #dcfce7; color: #2f855a; }

.grignan-home .video-idea-card h4 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 15.5px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #293747 !important;
  margin: 0 0 8px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
  text-align: left !important;
}

.video-idea-script {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border-left: 3px solid #2f855a;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.48;
  color: #293747;
}

.video-idea-note {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #526477;
  margin: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   ENCADRÉ CONCOURS VIDÉO & RÈGLES DU JEU
===================================== */

.concours-banner {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fdf6f6 0%, #f7ebeb 100%);
  border: 1px solid #e2bdbd;
  border-left: 5px solid #8c2d2d;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
}

.concours-icon {
  flex: 0 0 66px;
  width: 66px;
  height: 66px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e2bdbd;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.concours-icon svg {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
}

.concours-body {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.concours-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.grignan-home .concours-body h4 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #6e2020 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
}

.concours-tag {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: #8c2d2d;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.concours-body p {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #4a2525;
  margin: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   SECTION REVUE DE PRESSE & VIDÉO TV
===================================== */

.grignan-home .media-satire-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr !important;
  gap: 22px !important;
  align-items: stretch !important;
}

/* UNE D'ARTICLE SATIRIQUE — ASPECT PAPIER JOURNAL + TIMES NEW ROMAN */

.article-une-card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 26px 26px 22px;
  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, Georgia, serif !important;
  color: #1f1c18 !important;
  background-color: #f9f4e8;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(rgba(120, 102, 72, 0.08) 1px, transparent 0),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #fcf8ef 0%, #f5eddc 100%);
  background-size: 14px 14px, 100% 100%;
  border: 1px solid #cfc2a9;
  border-radius: 2px 2px 16px 2px;
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 #ffffff inset,
    3px 6px 16px rgba(41, 35, 24, 0.14);
}

/* Double filet journal en haut */
.article-une-card::before {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 4px;
  border-top: 2px solid #2b2620;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #2b2620;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

/* Coin de papier légèrement corné en bas à droite */
.article-une-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(130, 114, 86, 0.22) 50%, #F4F0E8 50%);
  border-top-left-radius: 4px;
}

.article-une-kicker {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, Georgia, serif !important;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.4px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #5c492c;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #8a7350;
  padding-bottom: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.grignan-home .article-une-card h4 {
  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, Georgia, serif !important;
  font-size: 25px !important;
  line-height: 1.2 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #1a1714 !important;
  margin: 0 0 14px !important;
  padding-bottom: 12px !important;
  border-bottom: 2px double #7d6d55 !important;
  text-align: left !important;
}

.article-une-chapo {
  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, Georgia, serif !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 1.58 !important;
  color: #24201b !important;
  text-align: justify;
  margin: 0 0 16px !important;
}

.article-une-chapo::first-letter {
  float: left;
  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 46px;
  line-height: 0.85;
  padding-top: 4px;
  padding-right: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #1a1714;
}

.article-une-footer {
  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, Georgia, serif !important;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #5c492c;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-top: 10px;
  border-top: 2px double #8a7350;
}

/* ENCART VIDÉO KARINE DUBERNET (FORMAT PLUS CARRÉ 4:5) */

.tv-clip-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 22px;
  background: #f7f8f8;
  border: 1px solid #c6f6d5;
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(47, 133, 90, 0.05);
}

.tv-clip-kicker {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #2f855a;
  background: #dcfce7;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.grignan-home .tv-clip-card h4 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 16.5px !important;
  line-height: 1.35 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #26394d !important;
  margin: 0 0 12px !important;
  border: none !important;
  text-align: left !important;
}

.tv-reel-wrapper {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 340px;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
  margin: 0 auto 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #cfdbe6;
  background: #141c24;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(41,55,71,0.12);
}

.tv-reel-wrapper iframe {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: none;
}

.tv-clip-footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.tv-clip-desc {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.48;
  color: #526477;
  margin: 0;
}

.tv-fb-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 7px 12px;
  background: #2f855a;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border: 1px solid #276749;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}

.tv-fb-link:hover {
  background: #276749;
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* =====================================
   MUR DES SLOGANS FAÇON POST-IT PAPIER
===================================== */

.slogans-wall {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #c6f6d5;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 28px 28px 26px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(47, 133, 90, 0.06);
}

.grignan-home .postit-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  gap: 20px !important;
}

.postit-note {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 150px;
  padding: 22px 18px 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, #fff9d2 0%, #f9eeaa 100%);
  border: 1px solid #e6d78a;
  border-radius: 2px 2px 14px 2px;
  box-shadow: 2px 5px 12px rgba(41, 55, 71, 0.11);
  transform: rotate(-1deg);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.postit-note:nth-child(2n) {
  transform: rotate(1.1deg);
}

.postit-note:nth-child(3n) {
  transform: rotate(-0.6deg);
}

.postit-note:hover {
  transform: rotate(0deg) translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 4px 9px 18px rgba(41, 55, 71, 0.16);
  z-index: 2;
}

/* Bande adhésive / effet papier collé en haut */
.postit-note::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -7px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 54px;
  height: 14px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.62);
  border: 1px solid rgba(180, 170, 140, 0.35);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}

/* Coin corné en bas à droite */
.postit-note::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.06) 50%, #ffffff 50%);
  border-top-left-radius: 4px;
}

/* Variantes de couleurs papier */
.postit-note--rose {
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, #fde8e8 0%, #f7d2d2 100%);
  border-color: #e2b4b4;
}

.postit-note--mint {
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, #e5f5f1 0%, #d1ebe4 100%);
  border-color: #b1d6cc;
}

.postit-note--sky {
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, #e8f1fa 0%, #d4e4f4 100%);
  border-color: #b4cde4;
}

.postit-quote-icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  opacity: 0.72;
}

.postit-text {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.44;
  color: #263544;
  margin: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   ENCADRÉ APPEL À CARICATURES & DESSINS
===================================== */

.caricature-callout {
  margin-top: 26px;
  padding: 18px 22px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eef6f4 0%, #e4f0ed 100%);
  border: 1px solid #c3dcd6;
  border-left: 5px solid #5d978b;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
}

.caricature-icon {
  flex: 0 0 64px;
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #c3dcd6;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.caricature-icon svg {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
}

.caricature-body {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.grignan-home .caricature-body h4 {
  font-family: 'Comfortaa', Arial, sans-serif !important;
  font-size: 15.5px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #28574e !important;
  margin: 0 0 5px !important;
  border: none !important;
}

.caricature-body p {
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: #365750;
  margin: 0;
}

/* =====================================
   RESPONSIVE
===================================== */

@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .grignan-home .postit-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .grignan-home .video-ideas-grid,
  .grignan-home .media-satire-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }

  .satire-rubrique-header h3 {
    white-space: normal !important;
    font-size: 15px !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .grignan-home .postit-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }

  .grignan-home .gazette-masthead h2 {
    font-size: 23px !important;
  }

  .gazette-hero-bg {
    width: 155px;
    height: 155px;
    right: -24px;
    bottom: -20px;
  }

  .gazette-slogan-banner {
    font-size: 16px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
  }

  .concours-banner,
  .caricature-callout {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .lavande-filigrane {
    width: 110px;
    right: -12px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.12;
  }

  .ble-filigrane {
    width: 105px;
    left: -15px;
    bottom: 5px;
    opacity: 0.13;
  }
}
</style>

    <p class="video-idea-note">

      </blockquote>

    <p class="video-idea-note">

      <h4>Grignan, village banalement satanique ?</h4>
      <p class="article-une-chapo">
        Connu jusqu’ici pour son magnifique château classé deuxième monument préféré des Français en 2026, sa lavande et les lettres de Madame de Sévigné, le village de Grignan s’offre un virage inattendu : un portail monumental aux motifs macabres, voire diaboliques, facturé 200 000 € d'argent public sans demander leur avis aux habitants ni à l’Architecte des Bâtiments de France. Récit d’une métamorphose où le banal vire résolument au fantastique, quand l’indécence devient la règle et où la dilapidation des fonds publics se revendique comme du grand art…
      </p>
